algorithm_authority.state_makeblock: For non-genesis heights, state.MakeBlock sets timestamp = MedianTime(commit, state.LastValidators).
algorithm_authority.median_time: MedianTime includes every non-absent commit signature, looks up the validator voting power by address, and calls cmttime.WeightedMedian.
algorithm_authority.weighted_median: median = totalVotingPower/2; timestamps sorted ascending; first timestamp whose weight reaches/exceeds remaining median is returned.
